raw_text: The implications of China detecting INS Arihant are massive. India's entire sea-based nuclear deterrent relies on the SSBN being undetectable. If PLA Navy's underwater surveillance network can reliably track Arihant, India's second-strike capability is significantly degraded. The simultaneous deployment of a Type 093 SSN suggests China may be developing a trailing doctrine for Indian SSBNs. India needs to accelerate the S5 class submarine program urgently.
